modules.title: Carry-on
modules.lede: You can bring one piece of cabin baggage in Economy Class and two pieces in Business Class.

carryon_bag_dimensions.value: Economy Class: 1 piece; Business Class: 2 pieces. Each up to 55x40x23 cm.

carryon_weight.value: Cabin baggage must not exceed 8 kg.

personal_item.value: 1 smaller personal item, such as a handbag, camera bag, laptop bag or briefcase, no larger than 40x30x20 cm, to fit under the seat in front.

oversize_fee.value: Cabin baggage over the piece, weight or size limit must be checked into the hold, which may cost 89€ per piece.

piece_weight_economy.notes: Luxair Economy Class checked baggage allowance.

piece_weight_business.value: 2 pieces up to 32 kg (70 lbs) each
piece_weight_business.notes: Luxair Business Class checked baggage allowance.

piece_weight_first.value: 3 pieces up to 32 kg (70 lbs) each
piece_weight_first.notes: Luxair First Class checked baggage allowance.

modules.title: If your flight is delayed or cancelled
modules.lede: Luxair's General Conditions of Carriage say it applies the applicable passenger-rights regulations in a cancellation or delay.

refund.value: If Luxair cancels a flight or fails to operate it reasonably according to schedule, it refunds the full fare paid if no portion of the ticket has been used; if part has been used, at least the difference between the fare paid and the fare for the portion flown.

regulations.value: In a cancellation or delay Luxair implements the provisions of the applicable regulations; its conditions refer to Regulation (EC) No 261/2004 on compensation and assistance.
